Orange Fruit Dip
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 12:03am

Ingredients




1 pkt (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 cup Marshmallow creme
Grated peel of 1 orange

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate. Serve with fresh fruit, such as grapes, apple or pear slices, or pineapple or melon chunks. Dip apple and pear slices in orange or lemon juice before serving to prevent browning.
